title: MosaiClusteR: an umbrella framework for multi-source and multi-omics clustering
text: Every method MosaiClusteR speaks language. Input List numeric matrices, one per source, measured objects order. convention objects rows, features columns (n objects x m_k features source k). Sources may different numbers features; need share objects. Output small list two standard components: DistM (object--object dissimilarity, n x n) Clust (fitted hierarchical clustering). methods additionally return $cluster label vector. Methods work precomputed dissimilarity accept type = "dist"; otherwise type = "data" (default) starts raw matrices. interface uniform, swapping one method another one-line change, evaluation / visualisation tools work . package ships small toy data set — two sources 60 shared objects three planted groups — used throughout vignette. can also simulate structured multi-source data mosaic_sim():

text: Many partitions “vote” whether pair objects belongs together; consensus co-membership clustered. CEC — (Consensus) Ensemble Clustering incidence accumulation across sources cut points; weight-aware. CVAA — Cumulative Voting Adjusted Aggregation, aligning partitions reference merging. title: MosaiClusteR 1.0.0
text: Cluster() now forwards normalisation method Distance(). Previously method argument documented accepted silently ignored, normalize = TRUE select method. normalize now accepts either logical (FALSE none) normalisation method name, method sets method normalize = TRUE. Documentation examples now use objects--rows orientation consistently (Cluster() example longer transposes bundled mosaic_toy data). cluster_agreement() edge cases. Identical partitions (relabelling) now return 1 ARI, NMI Jaccard, including degenerate single-cluster -singleton cases previously returned 0. Missing (NA) labels now raise clear error instead cryptic “missing value TRUE/FALSE needed”. ADC() ADEC() validate align sources object identifier combining . Reordered rows aligned first source; sources without row names combined positionally (previously failed “need least two non-NA values interpolate”); mismatched object sets, differing row counts duplicated identifiers now raise clear errors instead cryptic “subscript bounds”. mosaic_labels() validates k (single positive integer) clear message, instead silently truncating non-integer k failing cryptically NA. M_ABC() ADEC() gained seed argument reproducible results, consistent M_ABCdeep() intNMF(). documentation states stochastic seed (set.seed()) fixes result. M_ABC() now aligns sources object identifier building consensus, source reordered rows longer changes result; also evaluates List argument seeding argument uses RNG offset internal random stream. CEC() uses alignment now accepts sources without row names (combined positionally) instead failing “need least two non-NA values interpolate”. Error messages missing optional Bioconductor packages (used pathway gene-set functions) now give exact installation command, example BiocManager::install("MLP"), instead “needed function work”. CRAN-package messages already named install.packages().
